names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 12 octombrie, «Sfântul Ierarh Cosma, Episcopul Maiumei»; the life on the same site spells it Cozma.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 14 Οκτωβρίου, «Άγιος Κοσμάς ο Μελωδός επίσκοπος Μαϊουμά», with the rank word left off.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 12 октября ст. ст. — «Прп. Космы, еп. Маиумского, творца канонов (ок. 787).»
source.note: The rank is the alt text of the icon standing immediately before this line, «Cовершается служба, не отмеченная в Типиконе никаким знаком» — a service the Typikon marks with no sign at all. The day's other icon of the same kind stands before the Tarsus martyrs and does not reach this line.

attestations.note: The Russian keeps him on 12 October, the day the Romanian keeps him on, and the Greek keeps him on 14 October — the disagreement the folder already carried, now with a second church on the Romanian's side. Its life agrees with saint.gr on the schooling in the house of John of Damascus's parents and on the year of the consecration, 743, and names what he left: canons for the feast days and the triodia for four days of Holy Week. It is the one source that says the two of them wrote against the iconoclasts rather than only for the icons.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 12 octombrie — «Sfântul Ierarh Cosma, Episcopul Maiumei»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 14ης Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιος Κοσμάς ο Μελωδός επίσκοπος Μαϊουμά»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 14 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους» and «Αγιος Κοσμας ο Μελωδος Επισκοπος Μαϊουμα (; - 787)». **The folder's Romanian row stands on 12 October and the Greek calendar keeps him on 14 October**, which is two churches and not two men: the entry is unmistakably the melodist brought up by Sergius the father of John of Damascus, taught with John by the monk Cosmas of Calabria, received at the monastery of Saint Sabbas, and made bishop of Maiouma. He is **not** on saint.gr's 12 Οκτωβρίου listing, which was checked when that day was read. The page gives 787 for his repose in its head and 743 for his consecration in its text, and a `dates` object carries the first of those, because the folder had none; the second is a date of office and the schema has no field for it, so it is in the paragraph instead. The page prints two apolytikia; the first, Ἦχος πλ. δ’, which names him and gives no model, is taken, and the «Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον», Ἦχος δ’ «Ταχὺ προκατάλαβε», which also names him, is not drafted. **For the writer: the page gives a see, «επίσκοπος Μαϊουμά», and `upgrade.py` has no key for `office`.** No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
Not checked: pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

hymns.text: Îndreptătorule al Ortodoxiei, învăţătorule al dreptei cinstiri de Dumnezeu şi al curăţiei şi luminătorule al lumii, podoaba călugărilor cea de Dumnezeu insuflată Sfinte Părinte Cosma, înţelepte, cu învăţăturile tale pe toţi i-ai luminat. Alăută duhovnicească, roagă-te lui Hristos Dumnezeu ca să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Ierarh Cosma, Episcopul Maiumei

english.text: O guide of Orthodoxy, teacher of true reverence for God and of purity, luminary of the world, God-inspired adornment of monks: O wise father Cosmas, by thy teachings thou hast enlightened all. O spiritual harp, pray to Christ God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Ὀρθοδοξίας ὁδηγέ, εὐσεβείας Διδάσκαλε καὶ σεμνότητος, τῆς Οἰκουμένης ὁ φωστήρ, τῶν Μοναζόντων θεόπνευστον ἐγκαλλώπισμα, Κοσμᾶ σοφέ, ταῖς διδαχαῖς σου πάντας ἐφώτισας, λύρα τοῦ Πνεύματος. Πρέσβευε Χριστῷ τῷ Θεῷ, σωθῆναι τὰς ψυχὰς ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος πλ. δ’ — the first of the two hymns on the page of «Άγιος Κοσμάς ο Μελωδός επίσκοπος Μαϊουμά», and it names him. The page gives no model for it.

english.text: Guide of Orthodoxy, teacher of piety and of reverence, luminary of the whole world, God-inspired adornment of monastics, wise Cosmas: by your teachings you enlightened all, lyre of the Spirit. Intercede with Christ our God that our souls be saved.

hymns.text: Православия наставниче,/ благочестия учителю и чистоты,/ вселенныя светильниче,/ архиереов богодухновенное удобрение,/ Космо премудре,/ ученьми твоими вся просветил еси, цевнице духовная,// моли Христа Бога спастися душам нашим.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 12 октября ст. ст. — «Тропарь преподобного Космы»
source.note: It names him, «Космо премудре», where the troparion doxologia.ro prints under him is the common of a hierarch with the name changed.

english.text: O teacher of Orthodoxy, instructor in piety and in purity, lamp of the whole world, God-inspired adornment of bishops: most wise Cosmas, by thy teachings thou hast enlightened all, O spiritual harp. Entreat Christ God that our souls be saved.

hymns.text: Украшен добродетельми, Космо богодухновенне,/ Церкве Христовы украшение был еси:/ песньми бо украсил еси сию, блаженне./ Но молися ко Господу избавитися нам от всяких козней ратника, тебе зовущим:// радуйся, отче требогате.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 12 октября ст. ст. — «Кондак преподобного Космы»

english.text: Adorned with virtues, O God-inspired Cosmas, thou wast the adornment of the Church of Christ, for thou didst adorn her with hymns, O blessed one. Pray then to the Lord that we who cry to thee be delivered from all the snares of the adversary: rejoice, O father rich in God.

death.note: saint.gr's page head: «Αγιος Κοσμας ο Μελωδος Επισκοπος Μαϊουμα (; - 787)». The page gives no year for his birth. days.pravoslavie.ru prints the same year twice with «ок.» in front of it — «Прп. Космы, еп. Маиумского, творца канонов (ок. 787)» on the day line and «Преставился он в глубокой старости (+ ок. 787)» at the end of its life — where saint.gr's heading gives it bare. The bound is left at the year both print.
